name: (02) Mortis (Path of the Four Humours) — 1 Basic — Kiss of the Dark Mother

system.description: By mixing your black bile with your blood and directing it to your mouth, you concoct a toxic substitute for saliva that makes your bite even more deadly. Once channeled, all bites for the rest of the scene do an additional level of aggravated damage. It takes one turn to clean the substance from your mouth.
